script:
Ma San (Steward)
Ma San's growth path was quite bumpy. To make a living, he did a lot of hard labor, but he refused to accept his current situation and always took advantage of people around him, so he had few friends.
In the 35th year of the Sea Calendar, Ma San was still worrying about making a living when he met a drunk man and went up to chat with him. Only then did he learn that the man was a martial arts master but had an incurable disease. The profit-seeking Ma San couldn't give up this opportunity and immediately thought of a way to make money.
He told the man that everyone must die eventually - the key is whether the death has value. Why not use this time to do what you want to do, complete unfinished business? After thinking for a long time, the man finally came around. He wanted to find martial arts masters to duel with and verify his martial way. This was naturally within Ma San's expectations, and what he did was set up an arena to attract audiences and collect entrance fees from them.
Ma San learned that the man was called Zhang Qing. Because they were all top masters, the price was set very high, and Ma San made a big profit. But later Zhang Qing was killed by others, his source of income was cut off, and he still had a pile of duel invitations that hadn't been sent out. Zhang Qing had a disciple whom Ma San had seen, but after this, his disciple's whereabouts became unknown.
In the 36th year of the Sea Calendar, some time had passed since Zhang Qing's death, and his savings were almost spent - it was time to make the next plan. That year, an island was discovered by a merchant, the mining industry developed rapidly, and Ma San thought it was an opportunity. He heard that the big boss Chu Wanhu was recruiting a steward - this was a good position for "usurping power." With his shrewdness, he became the steward.
That same year, he followed Chu Wanhu to the island. Chu Wanhu had already established his own force called Longevity Gate. In the gate, he met the highly skilled doctor Su Shengce. A few years later, Chu Wanhu married a young concubine Wang Tingting. His son Chu Chuan spent his days idling on the island, living a life of debauchery. Not long after, a bodyguard Li Hao came. He immediately recognized that Li Hao was the disciple of that martial arts master from before, and the bodyguard also recognized him. So he took special care of this bodyguard, not because of their previous relationship, but because he had value to exploit. When bodyguard Li Hao asked Ma San about what happened back then, Ma San wanted to use him and thought the time wasn't right yet, only saying he would tell him later.
In the 48th year of the Sea Calendar, steward Ma San couldn't sleep and went out on patrol. Walking to a remote place, he discovered some movement. Getting closer, he saw that bodyguard Li Hao was practicing martial arts. He quietly followed to watch and discovered that Li Hao was practicing martial arts famous in the martial world - the Killing Arrow Technique. So Li Hao was the legendary assassin Black Kill.
In the 52nd year of the Sea Calendar, Ma San had been the steward on the island for more than ten years. During this time, he had been unwell many times and went to find doctor Su Shengce. The doctor always prescribed medicine for him, but after taking the medicine, not only did his health not improve, he even coughed up blood. Ma San felt this doctor was harming him and wanted to find an opportunity to eliminate Dr. Su.
One day, Chu Wanhu and Wang Tingting held a criticism meeting because his son Chu Chuan had relations with the maid Tang Yaoyao - what would people think if this got out? Chu Wanhu didn't speak, just stood aside in a daze. Tang Yaoyao shouted loudly, "Master, save me! I know Madam's secret!" Wang Tingting panicked and immediately had Tang Yaoyao taken away, instructing the steward to "handle it cleanly." Ma San killed Tang Yaoyao. Chu Wanhu no longer dealt with business, leaving everything to Wang Tingting. Young master Chu Chuan continued his usual life among flowers. Ma San felt it was time to start implementing his ambitions.
In the 55th year of the Sea Calendar, on September 25th, Ma San watched as Chu Wanhu's health deteriorated day by day and his mind became increasingly muddled. In Ma San's heart, he no longer posed a threat. Eliminate Wang Tingting and that playboy, and he could monopolize Longevity Gate. He collected some rat poison, planning to regularly poison Wang Tingting's cup. Since Wang Tingting and Chu Wanhu lived together, Ma San didn't know which cup was Wang Tingting's, so he could only poison every cup. Afraid of being discovered, he used very small amounts each time.
[September 27th]
7 PM: Ma San went to find Li Hao, thinking it was time to use him. Coming to Li Hao's room, he told him that the killer of his master was actually Chu Wanhu. Chu Wanhu knew some martial arts before but was far inferior to his master. However, poison was put in the tea on the day of the duel, and it was doctor Su Shengce who poisoned it. He also told Li Hao that he didn't tell him before because he wanted to see if these people had any repentance, but after so many years, they hadn't reformed at all. Seeing Li Hao's murderous eyes, Ma San was secretly pleased and returned to his room.
8:35 PM: In his room, Ma San heard hurried running sounds coming from the direction of Chu Wanhu's room, followed by dragging footsteps accompanied by the friction sound of supporting against railings.
Only Clue (Exposure -10 points): Li Hao is the famous Black Kill of the martial world.
acts_goal: Don't expose that Li Hao is the famous Black Kill of the martial world.
